title: Bank Statements
subtitle: Import bank statement files and review imported batches.
empty: No import batches match the current filters.

import.title: Import bank statement
import.help: Upload a CSV or XLSX file with a header row: Date, Amount, Type, Description, DocumentNumber (optional). Valid rows are imported as unmatched lines; invalid or duplicate rows are reported below.
import.missingInput: Choose a subsidiary and a file first.

reject.title: Reject batch
reject.notice: Rejecting invalidates every line in this batch. This action is all-or-nothing and cannot be undone. A reason is required.

error.loadFailed: Could not load bank statement batches.
error.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
